method: builtin image_gen; one call per asset

prompts.biography:
Use case: illustration-story, historical-fantasy montage.
Asset type: Premium Chinese fantasy card-game biography illustration, landscape 1536 x 1024. A completely NEW narrative composition, NOT a reuse of the card pose or card composition.
Reference image: The supplied approved five-star divine Guan Yu card is an IDENTITY AND PALETTE reference only. Preserve recognizable ruddy red face, long BLACK beard, mature stern noble features, green cloth headgear with gold crown, emerald green and gold dragon-trimmed garments, white lining and red ribbons. Do not edit or reproduce the card itself.
Primary story: The worship of Guan Yu by generations of ordinary people and later imperial courts. A majestic horizontal temple-worship scroll, human ritual is the focus, not a giant standing hero portrait. Three successive temple courtyards suggest separate late-imperial eras, connected by a broad unified ribbon of incense and golden light. In each courtyard a differently dressed ceremonial sovereign or court delegation offers respectful incense or a bow toward a shrine, surrounded by ordinary women and men, elders, travelers and soldiers. Suggest different Song/Ming/Qing-style periods through restrained costume silhouettes. These are an artistic cross-era symbolic montage, visibly separated by temple colonnades and atmospheric transitions, NOT a literal meeting of emperors and NOT a documentary assertion that all rulers personally worshipped Guan Yu. Absolutely no Qin emperor.
Composition: Broad temple architecture, red columns and green-gold eaves anchor the wide composition. People and rituals occupy roughly two thirds of the scene. Foreground ordinary worshippers and kneeling ceremonial rulers are clearly readable, not a sea of noisy specks. In the sanctuary above and behind the altar, a smaller spiritually manifested Guan Yu sits in dignified three-quarter profile with hands resting calmly, quietly watching over people. His recognizable green-gold form is integrated with temple incense and one coherent luminous aureole. His head has a more sacred gold crown with a central jade crest and clean structured sun-halo, not merely an ordinary cap. He should feel the same approved five-star identity but NOT match the chest-hand / outward-palm standing card pose.
Art direction: Epic painterly Chinese historical fantasy, confident large shapes, rich red temple geometry, jade green cloth, broad warm gold illumination, quiet dark shadow masses, soft atmospheric planes. One connected sacred light mass, broad ribbons of incense, restrained detail on the focal faces. Clear hierarchy and clean silhouette.
Avoid: Glitter, granular point lights, tiny sparkles, fireworks, dense glyph noise, particulate spray, broken dappled lighting, busy edge noise, unreadable crowds, copied card framing, giant deity dominating the whole page, six arms, six-star motifs, modern clothing, text, captions, logos, UI, borders, watermark. Fully painted opaque background.
prompts.skill-cg:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserve character skill illustration.
Asset type: Premium Chinese fantasy card-game STATIC active-skill keyframe CG, landscape 1536 x 1024, genuine transparent RGBA background.
Reference image: Use the approved five-star divine Guan Yu card ONLY as character identity and costume reference, NOT as a pose/composition template. Preserve the ruddy red face and long flowing BLACK beard, mature noble masculine facial identity, emerald and gold dragon-trimmed robe-armor, white lining, red wrist ribbons, jade-green headcloth. This is the five-star divine form, single head and exactly TWO arms, not six-star multi-armed form.
Primary request: A striking inventive MOMENT OF CASTING the team-protection ability. Full character in a twisting midair martial lunge, torso bending dynamically on a diagonal, one knee lifted and the opposite leg extending backward. BOTH arms are raised above the brow and bent to bring the wrists together in a deliberate two-hand sacred seal, visibly different from a hand over chest or palm offered forward. Hands must be anatomically clear and separated from the face. The figure has real weight shift, angular elbows and flowing robe sweep, an unmistakable action pose rather than standing to bless. Face visible in intense three-quarter view, crown not obscured by hands.
Divinity at head: Upgrade the head ornament into a prominent elegant gold-and-jade divine crown integrated with the green headcloth, a tall central jade-and-gold crest and symmetrical sculpted golden wings, plus a clean solid-edged golden sun disc behind the head. This sacred head silhouette must be immediately readable. Preserve the five-star design language, no extra head or arms.
Skill visual: From the joined sacred seal a single broad white-gold current curves down with the twisting gesture and opens into THREE large translucent jade-gold shield petals around the lower body, visibly forming the leading edges of one protective dome for a team. The connected force sweep and broad barrier surfaces communicate defensive divine power, not a sword attack. No weapon. Red ribbons and robe follow the same large C-shaped spiral. One integrated concentrated spell effect, clean broad shapes, controlled brightness and readable negative space.
Composition: Entire figure including crown, feet, hand seal and primary shield contours fits comfortably inside the canvas with breathing room. Strong diagonal silhouette and dynamic foreshortening, centered slightly left with shield arc opening to the right. No ground, no temple, no sky, no scenery, no other characters. All non-character and non-effect regions must be truly transparent alpha, NOT a checkerboard, flat grey/black/green backdrop or opaque glow rectangle.
Art direction: High-end painterly fantasy illustration, polished broad directional light, jade/green/gold/ivory with scarlet ribbon accents, cohesive heroic anatomy, elegant premium shapes. Broad soft-edged light on armor, well-defined face and sacred crown. Use meaningful big energy ribbons, no granular particles.
Avoid: The approved card standing pose, hand-over-chest pose, generic one-hand palm-out blessing, stiff upright body, six arms, six-star transformation, detached extra limbs, weapons, text, logos, UI, card frame, sparkles, starry dust, glitter, tiny scattered points, noisy luminous filigree, confetti, bright background haze. GENUINE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND required.
